rows.post: CMS Developer (Drupal Headless) / Sr. CMS Developer

content_sections.heading: AMTRON Recruitment 2026 Job Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Responsible for developing and maintaining responsive, citizen-facing web interfaces using React JS, in line with the AUP dual-zone architecture (Citizen Portal and Internal Publisher's Workbench). Key skills include React JS, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API integration, OAuth2/JWT, Git, and basic Linux/Docker knowledge. Responsible for building and maintaining backend services and REST APIs using Python (FastAPI), handling authentication flows, and working with PostgreSQL/MySQL databases. Key skills include Python, FastAPI, database management, API security, and microservice architecture. Responsible for implementing a headless CMS architecture using Drupal, exposing content via REST/JSON APIs for the React frontend and mobile application. Key skills include Drupal, PHP, content modelling, and REST/JSON:API exposure. Responsible for planning, creating, editing, and publishing content for the Assam Unified Portal, ensuring compliance with GIGW 3.0 standards. Key skills include strong written and spoken English (Assamese preferred), Drupal or equivalent CMS knowledge, and proofreading ability. Responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining Drupal database environments on MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL platforms. Key skills include database administration, backup and recovery, performance tuning, and data migration. Responsible for designing website banners, icons, infographics, and other digital assets in compliance with Government of Assam branding and GIGW 3.0 guidelines. Key skills include Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, and web design principles.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AMTRON Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents while submitting the online application. Photograph and signature must be in JPG/JPEG format (each less than 100 KB); all other documents must be in PDF format (maximum 2 MB per file): Age Proof: 10th standard Admit Card/Certificate or Birth Certificate Latest passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, less than 100 KB) Scanned copy of signature (JPG/JPEG, less than 100 KB) Photo Identity Card: PAN Card/Driving Licence/Passport/Voter ID Card/Aadhaar Card, or any other ID issued by a Government agency Address Proof: Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, electricity bill, ration card, passport, or driving licence Educational Qualification certificates from Xth standard onward Professional/relevant certificates, as applicable to the post applied for Work Experience Certificate(s) issued by previous employers Caste/Category Certificate issued by competent authority, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AMTRON Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply only online through the official AMTRON recruitment portal. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted. The steps to apply are as follows: Visit the official website: recruitment.amtron.in Register on the website Login using the Registration Number and Date of Birth Fill up the application form and upload all the required documents Submit the online application form and retain the acknowledgment for future reference

content_sections.heading: AMTRON Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Online applications will be shortlisted based on eligibility criteria and educational qualification. The list of shortlisted candidates will be uploaded on recruitment.amtron.in, and shortlisted candidates will additionally be intimated by email. For Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, CMS Developer, and Database Administrator posts: Technical/Practical Assessment along with Viva-Voce For Content Manager and Graphic Designer posts: Viva-Voce along with a review of portfolio/work samples Final selection is based on performance in the Technical/Practical Assessment and Viva-Voce (as applicable), educational qualification, and relevant work experience. Assignment of the Senior (Sr.) designation additionally requires a minimum of five years of relevant post-qualification experience, as decided solely by the Selection Committee. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 12.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies across six posts: Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, CMS Developer, Content Manager, Database Administrator, and Graphic Designer.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, no application fee is payable for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 38 years as on 1st January 2026, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PwD candidates as per Government of Assam norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only online through recruitment.amtron.in. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salaries range from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 90,000 per month depending on the post and the candidate's assessed proficiency and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Developer and Database Administrator posts involve a Technical/Practical Assessment and Viva-Voce; Content Manager and Graphic Designer posts involve a Viva-Voce and portfolio review.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job or a contractual position?
faq.answer: This is a purely contractual engagement, initially for 11 months, extendable annually up to a maximum of 3 years based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a domicile requirement for AMTRON AUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Preference is given to candidates with Assam domicile, though the notice does not state this as an absolute eligibility requirement.
